items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: I love him. He’s a nice contrast.

ctx.x: Keeping time. Bill Crow, the great bass player and humorist, he used to make tee shirts that said, “So many drummers, so little time.” I’m sure you know that.
That’s a good one. He played here one year for Fallcoming.
